captions.detailed: A classic countertop milkshake spindle mixer featuring a beige oval base and a tall vertical support post. A cantilevered beige motor head is connected to the top of the post via a black revolute pivot joint, allowing it to tilt up and down. Extending down from the motor head is a thin, silver-colored mixing spindle that rotates continuously inside a grey tapered mixing cup resting on a black circular base plate.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a countertop milkshake spindle mixer. The assembly should feature an oval base, a vertical support post, a mixing cup, and a tilting motor head mounted on a revolute joint at the top of the post that drives a continuous rotating mixing spindle.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat extruded oval sketch combined with a circular cup holder plate. Create the support post using a tall cylinder anchored to the base with a square block. Model the motor head by combining extruded profiles with rounded fillets, and attach it to the post top using a revolute joint. Finally, construct the mixing cup using a hollowed, tapered cylinder, and model the spindle as a thin cylinder attached to the motor head via a continuous rotational joint.
